scope: 65 stored Swedish-language representations for the registered English core inventory: 23 expansion representations accepted at local-representation scope and 42 earlier representations retained with their prior entry-level review states.
acceptance_scope: Per-entry states are preserved. The 23 expansion representations retain their recorded local-representation acceptance; the 40 earlier EU/case-law conversions retain accepted-prior status with failed live rechecks, and two earlier guidance conversions remain candidates not trust-promoted. This index does not certify legal force, full source completeness, topic coverage, or country completion.
